# EarnFlow.in - Four Digit Lottery Platform

> EarnFlow.in is an online, provably fair gaming platform dedicated exclusively to the Four Digit Lottery. Players choose a four-digit combination (0000–9999) or use Quick Pick to participate in scheduled transparent draws with real-time wallet settlement.

## Platform Summary
- **Official Domain**: https://earnflow.in
- **Sole Active Game**: Four Digit Lottery
- **Fairness Model**: Provably Fair cryptographic verification (SHA-256 & HMAC)
- **Currency / Asset**: USDT (TRC-20) / FLO (1 FLO = 1 USDT) and INR gateways
- **Minimum Age**: 18+ strictly enforced
- **Support Contact**: earnflow.user@gmail.com

## Four Digit Lottery Game Overview
- **Objective**: Select a 4-digit number between 0000 and 9999.
- **Ticket Rule**: Single ticket per purchase action (Total Cost = Unit Price).
- **Selection Modes**: Interactive tactile numeric keypad or automated Quick Pick generator.
- **Draw Frequency**: Scheduled live event rounds backed by Supabase backend and Provably Fair random generation.
- **Instant Settlement**: Winnings are automatically credited to the verified player wallet upon draw completion.

## Legal and Compliance Notice
EarnFlow.in operates strictly under transparent Provably Fair protocols. Participation is restricted to individuals 18 years of age or older in jurisdictions where skill-based and digital lottery participation is legally permitted.
